name: The Role of Technology and Design on Growth in China
description: Given the remarkable economy and society progresses achieved by modern China in the past decades, it has been a phenomenal topic of how China imports, learns, and innovates technologies and designs, as well as what exactly is the role of the technology and design in the middle of boosting the rapid development of China economy. In the context of modern China’s ‘reform and open’ policies, this course describes and explains the role of technology and design, respectively. The course covers the role of technology and design in the past, present, and future
